verdict.rationale: Railway's own marketing says every pull request gets its own preview, and that it supports unlimited environments, so per-PR previews are a first-party capability. The evidence does not say these previews spin up the whole stack (services plus databases), or that they are torn down automatically on merge or close. The community items are about outages and trust, not previews, so they were not weighed. Missing for 10: documentation that PR previews replicate the entire multi-service stack including data services, documented automatic teardown or ephemeral lifecycle, in-depth docs beyond homepage marketing lines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get ephemeral full-stack preview environments for every pull request

citations.quote: Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.
Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
